issues.message: Month-end is not defined. V2 uses: the last weekday (Mon-Fri) of the calendar month, London date of the entry; reporting tag only, no effect on trades. Reply CONFIRMED or give the definition; a different definition only re-runs the month-end split.

Doubled-cost stress = net R with each trade's spread, commission and slippage x 2, computed from the trades (no swap: same-day exits). V2's own stressed level stays costs x 1.5 and is reported next to it.
No London-fix holiday calendar: every weekday with a [16:02,16:03) London M1 bar trades; holiday contamination is not flagged (your known gap).
